# Om Ramanathan

> Official website of Om Ramanathan, a New Jersey student engineer, Raider Robotics FTC Team 17670 captain, founder, AI researcher, and STEM community leader.

## Profile

- [Home](https://www.omramanathan.com/): Overview of Om Ramanathan and his current work.
- [Professional profile](https://www.omramanathan.com/#experience): Experience, education, certifications, volunteering, and skills.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/omramanathan/): Om Ramanathan's public LinkedIn profile.

## Engineering and leadership

- Robotics Team Captain, Raider Robotics FTC Team 17670 at Scotch Plains-Fanwood High School, May 2026–present. Robot programming, sensor integration, autonomous systems, and team leadership.
- Independent AI Researcher, October 2025–present. Embedded systems and machine learning on microcontrollers.
- Chapter Leader, STEM Enrichment of New Jersey, May 2026–present. Free, hands-on STEM workshops.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://www.omramanathan.com/#projects): The Real Temp, RoadSeal, and engineering work.
- [AI Implementation on Microcontrollers](https://www.omramanathan.com/#ai-research): TinyML research, listed on LinkedIn as pending IEEE publication.
- [The Real Temp](https://therealtemp.com/): Weather product founded, designed, and developed by Om Ramanathan.
